script.title: How Indian Oil Made ₹22,500 Cr Profit in 90 Days #shorts

segments.text: Indian Oil just made over ₹22,000 crore profit in three months.
That is almost ₹240 crore pure profit every single day.
But just a quarter ago, they were actually losing money.
So how did an oil PSU flip from loss to massive profits so fast?
It comes down to Gross Refining Margins, or GRMs.
When international crude prices drop, Indian Oil buys cheap oil but sells petrol at steady local prices.
They pocket the massive difference on every single litre you fill.
This isn't financial advice, but that secret margin surge is why...
